svg.title: Task 1 objects and actions
svg.desc: A diagram of the PDDL objects for Task 1 and the eight actions between them. Each object is a red box with its type above it. Top row, left to right: the cells c1 c2 c3 c4; inspection robot 1; tester1 above tester2; inspection robot 2. Below inspection robot 2, on the right, a dashed gray box, the recycling bin, which is not an object. Bottom row, left to right: the station shipping; agv1, whose tray holds four slots s1 to s4; and the station inspection, joined to agv1 by a short line. Arrows with numbered tags: 1 from the cells to inspection robot 1; 2 from it to each tester; 3 from each tester to inspection robot 2; 4 from it down to agv1; 5 from it down to the recycling bin. Tag 6 sits at agv1's top left corner, an arrow with tag 7 goes from agv1 left to shipping, and tag 8 sits left of shipping.
